tasks.analysis: Fossils provide invaluable evidence of evolutionary history, documenting species that lived millions of years ago. Paleontologists examine these remains to understand how organisms have changed over time. Natural selection explains how advantageous traits increase in frequency in a population. Species adapt to their environments, which leads to incredible diversity observed in the biological world today through the mechanism of natural selection.
